newsitem.title: UK: London freight - BFI sheds another 13 points.
newsitem.headline: London freight - BFI sheds another 13 points.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index shed another 13 points to fix at 1,332, as the key U.S. Gulf/Japan grain route rate eased.
MBK fixed two unnamed Choyang vessels to carry 54,000 tonnes of heavy grain each U.S. Gulf/Japan at $21.50 basis no combination ports, down 50 cents from last reported.
Coal and ore fixtures were slack on Monday, with only the one capesize vessel noted. This was Cobam's fixing of 140,000 tonnes ore Ponta do Ubu/Rotterdam 15-30/5 at $6.
At 1245 GMT the BIFFEX futures were 10 to 25 points easier. Most active May traded last at 1,320, down 25. May volume was 22 lots, while the total volume only ammounted to 40 lots.
